intro.data: A real inverse works both ways. Your tray holds Decode and two encoders: bring Decode and the true encoder onto the board and wire them so the blob decodes then re-encodes back to the very same blob. One encoder restores it; the other makes a different blob. Wire the true one and leave the other in the tray.
intro.alchemy: A real inverse works both ways. Your tray holds Recast and two grinds: bring Recast and the true grind onto the board and wire them so the dust recasts then re-grinds back to the same dust. One restores it, the other differs. Wire the true one and leave the other in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: A real inverse works both ways. Your tray holds Read and two etches: bring Read and the true etch onto the board and wire them so the glyph reads then re-etches back to the same glyph. One restores it, the other differs. Wire the true one and leave the other in the tray.
intro.abstract: Start from B, apply g then f, and return to the same B value. Here values are concrete: g sends 6♦ ↦ 6 and the true encoder sends 6 ↦ 6♦, so 6♦ reappears, while the fake one lands on 11 instead. Bring g and the true encoder from the tray and wire them, leaving the fake one behind.

goal.data: Bring Decode and an encoder from the tray and wire them so it decodes then re-encodes back to the very same packed blob.
goal.alchemy: Bring Recast and a grind from the tray and wire them so it recasts then re-grinds back to the same dust.
goal.spellcraft: Bring Read and an etch from the tray and wire them so it reads then re-etches back to the same glyph.
goal.abstract: Bring g and an A→B morphism from the tray and wire them so the round trip returns the original 6♦, leaving the fake one in the tray.

description.data: unpacks the blob back into data
description.alchemy: recasts the powder back into ore
description.spellcraft: reads the glyph back into a spark

afterSuccess.data: Decoding then encoding restored the original blob exactly: f ∘ g = id_B. With g ∘ f = id_A from before, Encode and Decode are inverses — an isomorphism, A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Recasting then grinding restored the dust: f ∘ g = id_B. With the other round trip, Grind and Recast are inverses — A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Reading then etching restored the glyph: f ∘ g = id_B. With the other round trip, Etch and Read are inverses — A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.abstract: The other round trip also returned home: f ∘ g = id_B. With both, f and g are inverses — A ≅ B.

reveal.summary: An isomorphism is a morphism with a two-sided inverse: g ∘ f = id_A and f ∘ g = id_B. The two objects are then interchangeable, written A ≅ B.
reveal.moreFormal: If both round trips are identities, f is an isomorphism and its inverse is unique.
